data.name: Paragnosia: Triple Curse
data.detailed_description:
Paragnosia: Triple Curse combines anomaly hunting with intense surveillance camera gameplay. You play as an exorcist sent by Cam-on-Rail to track down Sydney Scob, an urban explorer who recently went missing. Your mission: to monitor a likely haunted monastery for three nights, neutralize any paranormal activity, and save Sydney before it’s too late…

THREE ERA THAT HAVE LEFT THEIR MARK

The game takes place at Blackshore Abbey, a former Cistercian monastery that has fallen into oblivion after centuries of history. Explore its ruins, abandoned classrooms, and walled-up dormitories. Different eras intertwine here—from the traces of 11th-century monks to the young students of a 1950s boarding school, to today’s clandestine urban exploration tours. At Blackshore Abbey, certain phenomena don’t seem to belong to the world of the living…

THREE CHALLENGES TO OVERCOME

The hostile forces are so powerful that they cannot be confronted all at once. You’ll need to stay focused for 3 nights—3 levels of 8 hours each—to defeat the 3 sources of Evil. Each night, you’ll guide your camera along 3 different tracks that gradually reveal all the secrets of Blackshore Abbey.

Each hour brings its own set of supernatural changes, from the most obvious to the most subtle. Observe carefully, compare, and identify the anomalies that appear. At the end of each round, the system reveals how many you missed. Remember: the devil is in the details, and some anomalies can only be observed from very specific angles.

150 ANOMALIES

Each anomaly you miss shatters one of the six barriers protecting you from Evil. Lose them all before 8 a.m., and whatever haunts the monastery will descend upon you. To survive and banish the entities, vigilance is your only weapon.

Some manifestations require specific actions at the right moment to be exorcised. Sharpen your observational skills, adapt your strategy, and prepare to face 3 terrifying creatures.

With up to 150 anomalies to discover, completionists will have their work cut out for them.

PLAYTIME

2 to 5 hours

data.short_description: Use your track-mounted camera to monitor the ruins of a haunted monastery. Over the course of three 8-hour nights, track down and exorcise the anomalies by photographing them. Stay alert: if you let your guard down even for a moment, the occult forces will turn against you.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Creepy atmosphere, a few jumpscares, occasional bloodstain, death related content (skulls and bones)
